_meta.description: English — canonical source of truth for all UI strings

view.rescue.title: No active disruption
view.rescue.subtitle: Your flights are being monitored. The Autonomous Rescue Agent will activate instantly if any disruption is detected.
view.rescue.hint: Click "+ Add Flight" to monitor a flight, or "Simulate Disruption" to see the agent in action.
view.rescue.claims_sub: Checking your rights under global air-passenger regulations...
view.rescue.appeal_btn: Airline said no? Draft appeal letter
view.concierge.error: Sorry, I could not process your request right now.
view.radar.title: Autonomous Rescue Radar
view.radar.no_alerts: No disruptions detected. Radar standing by.
view.trip.hero_sub: Tell us where you need to go — we'll find options, show you the plan, and only book when you approve.
view.trip.sandbox_note: Offers come from the official Atlas Sandbox. Approval requests a Sandbox booking; if ticketing is unavailable, no PNR or ticket is created.
view.trip.options_empty: No flight options yet — submit a travel goal to begin.
view.trip.itinerary_note: flight status, suggestions and sources are labeled separately
view.trip.itinerary_empty: Nothing planned yet — complete-trip suggestions appear before booking approval.
view.trip.dag_empty: No nodes yet — the DAG fills in as the agent works (1s refresh).
view.trip.help_sandbox_a: Flight offers come from the official Atlas Sandbox, not a runtime mock fallback. Sandbox results are not production airline inventory, and provider booking limits are shown honestly.
view.trip.help_approval_a: The agent never books on its own. Before a booking attempt you see the exact provider offer and price, then approve it yourself. Approval can still fail safely when Sandbox ticketing is unavailable.
view.trip.help_change_q: How do I change my plan?
view.trip.help_change_a: Every finished step shows an Edit button — press it to re-open that step. Steps after it are updated afterwards, and we tell you before anything changes.
view.trip.help_disruption_q: What if my flight is disrupted?
view.trip.help_disruption_a: If something changes after booking, your original plan stays visible. We show replacement options with reasons, and nothing is rebooked without a separate approval from you.
view.trip.help_privacy_q: What do you store about me?
view.trip.help_privacy_a: Only what you save in "Your details", and only with your consent. Passport number, payment details, and legal identity are never collected or stored. You can delete any field at any time.
view.trip.help_goals_q: Good goals include from, to and when
view.trip.help_goals_a: Example: "Bangkok to Singapore, Sep 29–30, plan my whole trip." If we can't work the trip out, we'll ask one short question at a time.
trip_headline: Tell me where you need to be — I'll plan the rest.
trip_hero_sub: Goal intake → clarification → flights → visa check → your approval → sandbox booking. Every step appears live on the execution panel.
approval.kicker: Your decision needed · Atlas Sandbox booking
approval.title: Approve this booking?
approval.sub: Pick one flight, then press "Approve Sandbox booking". This requests a provider booking; no PNR is created unless Atlas confirms it.
drawer.title: Your details
drawer.consent_note: Only save details I give you. You can delete anything at any time.
drawer.privacy_note: Passport number, payment details, and legal identity are not stored by this demo. Only safe preferences (passport country, home city, cabin, budget, and similar) are kept — with your consent.
chips.trip.rights: What are my rights if cancelled?
timeline.empty: No itinerary yet — plan a trip to see your day-by-day timeline.
map.title: Trip Map
map.tile_failed: Map tiles unavailable — showing route summary only.
